lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 6-7 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs; the central-most visible column contains 4 distinct nodes spaced roughly equidistantly along the vertical axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a structured grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent reddish-pink circular zone of discoloration is present on the anterior section of the lateral flank, indicating potential tissue trauma or a parasitic lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high density of small, irregularly spaced punctate markings that contrast with the organized grid pattern of the primary flank.
